scripts.test: bun run test:frontend && bun run test:backend
scripts.lint: bun run lint:frontend && bun run lint:backend
scripts.format: bun run format:backend && bun run format:frontend
scripts.check: rm -f web/.vite-errors.log && bun run format && bun run lint && bun run build && bun scripts/assert-no-browser-errors.js
scripts.dev: cd web && php ../../backend/artisan optimize:clear && php ../../backend/artisan package:discover && concurrently --kill-others --hide "laravel queue,laravel scheduler,laravel reverb" -p "[{index}] [{name}]" -n "laravel,laravel queue,laravel reverb,vite+,laravel scheduler" "bun run serve" "php ../../backend/artisan queue:work --silent" "php ../../backend/artisan reverb:start --silent" "bun run dev" "php ../../backend/artisan schedule:work --silent"
scripts.dev:backend: cd web && php ../../backend/artisan optimize:clear && php ../../backend/artisan package:discover && concurrently --kill-others --hide "laravel queue,laravel scheduler,laravel reverb" -p "[{index}] [{name}]" -n "laravel,laravel queue,laravel reverb,laravel scheduler" "bun run serve" "php ../../backend/artisan queue:work --silent" "php ../../backend/artisan reverb:start --silent" "php ../../backend/artisan schedule:work --silent"
